rules: Open with one concise district identity sentence.
Use one bullet per adjacency transaction family.
Place the Quarter receipt before the return yield.
Use exact CSC material and sales icons.
Describe both halves of one bilateral transaction in one bullet.
Write from the described building's perspective.
Place the received effect before the counterparty effect.
Separate the service paragraph from transaction bullets with a blank line.
Name the unlock, supplied source, destination, and required customer building.
Use a service LOC substitution when the named service is reusable.
First identify where, when, and why the service is established.
Then state all implemented effects with exact icons and Great Person class.
State the service eligibility and complete effect after a paragraph break.
Preserve pre-existing destination descriptions when appending.
Use append-safe text-prefix behavior where supported.
Summarize the unlock relationship without inventing implementation detail.
